scripts.text:
[Helper Iriff]
Good day, challengers!
You are in the party arena waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[助手 伊里夫]
各位挑战者，你们好！
这里是队伍竞技场等待室。

scripts.text:
[Helper Iriff]
Only one person at a time is allowed to stay in this waiting room.
Would you like to start a battle now?
scripts.translation:
[助手 伊里夫]
这个等待室每次只允许一人停留。
现在要开始战斗吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Helper Iriff]
I see.
However, please remember you have only a limited amount of time.
scripts.translation:
[助手 伊里夫]
明白了。
不过，请记住，你能停留的时间有限。

scripts.text:
[Helper Iriff]
Thank you, let me start a battle.
A warp portal leading to the arena room will be open.
I hope you will survive until the end of the battle and engrave your name on the list of honor...
scripts.translation:
[助手 伊里夫]
谢谢，那就开始战斗吧。
通往竞技场的传送门即将开启。
希望你能坚持到战斗结束，在荣誉榜上留下自己的名字...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
You did a good job.
Even if you have failed to clear a time attack battle, I will reward you with a small amount of arena points.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
干得不错。
虽然你没能通过限时挑战，我还是会给你少量竞技场点数奖励。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Uh huh!
You already have enough arena points.
Please spend some arena points later. When I see you next time, I will make sure to give you some reward.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
嗯哼！
你的竞技场点数已经够多了。
之后先花掉一些点数吧。
下次见面时，我一定给你奖励。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let me guide you outside. I hope you had a good time.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
让我送你出去吧。
希望你玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Wow, you did a good job~ 
Your name is...^3131FF{0}^000000, isn't it?
^3131FF{1}^000000, total time you spent to pass the battle..

[Staff]
is {0}minutes {1}seconds.
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
是{0}分{1}秒。
恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
The fastest party among people who cleared party arena time force battle is ^3131FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
在通过队伍竞技场限时挑战的队伍中，速度最快的是^3131FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
^3131FF{0}^000000's running time was ^3131FF{1}^000000minutes ^3131FF{2}^000000seconds.

[Staff]
Although you failed to make a new record, I hope you will succeed next time.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
虽然这次没能刷新纪录，希望你下次能成功。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Then let me reward you with some arena points....eh?
Your arena points have exceeded the maximum amount. I cannot give you more points until you spend some points.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
那就给你一些竞技场点数奖励...咦？
你的竞技场点数已经超过上限了。
你得先花掉一些点数，我才能给你更多。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
You can check the amount of arena points you have in the arena waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你可以在竞技场等待室查询目前的竞技场点数。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I hope you had a good time and let me guide you to the entrance of arena.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
希望你玩得开心。
让我送你回竞技场入口吧。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let me reward you some arena points.
If you wish to check the amount of arena points you have, please go talk to ^3131FFVendigos^000000 at the arena entrance.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
让我给你发放竞技场点数奖励吧。
想查询目前的竞技场点数，请去竞技场入口找^3131FF文迪戈斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let me guide you to the entrance of arena.
See you later~
scripts.translation:
[职员]
让我送你回竞技场入口吧。
下次见~

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Wow! You have renewed the record!
What a great job!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
哇！你刷新了纪录！
干得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
You can record you and your party members on ^FF0000the hall of Arena Time Force Battle party ^000000.
When you enter a name, the name will be remained on the top unless someone make a new record.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你和队员们可以在^FF0000竞技场队伍限时挑战荣誉榜^000000上留名。
输入名字后，这个名字就会一直留在榜首，直到有人刷新纪录。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Please enter a name within 10 letters which can represent you and your party members.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
请输入一个不超过10个字符的名字，代表你和队员们。

scripts.text: Ok.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我想想

scripts.text:
[Staff]
You have entered ^3131FF{0}^000000. Is it correct?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Your record has been entered.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你的纪录已录入。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Please take your time and think up a nice name.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
请慢慢想，取一个好听的名字。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Please take your time and think up a nice name.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
请慢慢想，取一个好听的名字。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Then let me reward you with some arena points....eh?
Your arena points have exceeded the maximum amount. I cannot give you more points until you spend some points.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
那就给你一些竞技场点数奖励...咦？
你的竞技场点数已经超过上限了。
你得先花掉一些点数，我才能给你更多。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
You can check the amount of arena points you have in the arena waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你可以在竞技场等待室查询目前的竞技场点数。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I hope you had a good time and let me guide you to the entrance of arena.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
希望你玩得开心。
让我送你回竞技场入口吧。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let me reward you with some arena points.
At the same time, since you have renewed the record you will receive an extra amount of the points this time.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
让我给你发放竞技场点数奖励吧。
你刷新了纪录，所以这次还会获得额外点数。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let me reward you some arena points.
If you wish to check the amount of arena points you have, please go talk to ^3131FFVendigos^000000 at the arena entrance.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
让我给你发放竞技场点数奖励吧。
想查询目前的竞技场点数，请去竞技场入口找^3131FF文迪戈斯^000000。

scripts.text:

Let me guide you to the entrance of arena.
See you later~

让我送你回竞技场入口吧。
下次见~
